limitations: Local native platform was macOS 26.6.2 ARM64; remote CI was not executed in this turn.
Python 3.10 and 3.12/3.14 were not rerun locally.
Safari facade excludes frame switching, actions, concurrent sessions and PDF printing.
Standalone Chromium/CfT, Windows/Linux native targets, WebView2, beta/dev channels and casting hardware remain separately gated.
Browser HTTPS proxy test uses a disposable insecure-certificate setting; manager CONNECT test verifies fixture TLS trust and hostname.
Two-minute sustained sessions do not prove unlimited uptime or absence of memory leaks.
Explicit transaction child tasks inherit ownership; await dependent operations sequentially.
Options snapshots/profile copies remain synchronous; options mutation is not arbitrary-thread-safe.
Cleanup is not transactional filesystem rollback; authoritative Popen fallback cannot identify descendants that escaped before capture.
Audit skipped editable Aselenium; this is not a vulnerability assessment of own code.
No publication, commit, push, personal-profile mutation or Safari automation-setting changes.
